description: Get a USD starting price for one pool or spa service in the ZIP's market. Without a partner key, status starting_price is a market minimum, not a personalized quote; modifiers do not change it. Approved partner keys return status estimate with an indicative total. Monthly billing differs from weekly visits. For a customer quote, use the browser form at https://quote.cabanapools.com/. This tool does not submit that form, verify contact details, create leads or book service.

modifiers.description: Optional distinct modifier IDs allowed for this service by list_services. They affect partner estimates only, not anonymous starting prices.

serviceId.description: Service ID from list_services. Availability depends on the ZIP market.

zip.description: Five-digit US ZIP code for the service property, as a string. Do not send a street address or contact details.

name: estimate_pool_service
